evidence: NIOSH 94-110 (Rev. 9/2021), unnumbered table under section 1.3, printed page 7 (PDF page 23). The PDF text layer encodes this character as U+2212 MINUS SIGN, and the expression is a subtraction ('1 minus ...'). In the page image the glyph is longer than the hyphen in 'V-75', which is consistent with a minus sign; pass B typed it as U+2013 EN DASH.
